title: Persistent Implementation Lane Topology Repair
owner_directive: Replace the obsolete persistent lane topology with three independent parallel implementation lanes for MSAS, MRCS and MVPS. UISR-11 remains completed and must not occupy a persistent implementation slot. Preserve already-govern-started MSAS-01 exactly and preserve MVPS-10 selected_not_started while adding MRCS-01 selected_not_started.
reproduced_failures: CURRENT and LANES still define product-development, ui-implementation and player-species as the three persistent lanes even though UISR-11 completed and MSAS/MRCS/MVPS are the owner-approved parallel-safe workstreams.
The obsolete product-development umbrella serializes MSAS and MRCS selection even though ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json explicitly marks MCS/MCCS/MRCS/MSAS parallel-safe.
A new MRCS conversation could incorrectly replace or pause MSAS because MRCS has no independent persistent selector.
repair_scope: Create independent canonical persistent lanes msas, mrcs and mvps.
Preserve MSAS-01 in_progress checkpoint/branch/authority without mutation.
Preserve MVPS-10 selected_not_started checkpoint and add MRCS-01 selected_not_started checkpoint.
Retire UISR from the persistent-lane set while preserving UISR-11 completion evidence as completed program history.
Update bootstrap, operating contract, lane registry, CURRENT, validators, compatibility projections and regression tests so future conversations cannot silently collapse the three workstreams.
Do not change product implementation code or start MRCS-01/MVPS-10 during this operations repair.

stop_reason.evidence: OPS3-09 durable topology implementation is on AIOC main; this closeout clears the temporary new-start freeze and preserves independent MSAS/MRCS/MVPS selectors.

execution_conformance.note: One owner approval carried OPS3-09 through governed start, topology implementation, exact-head validation/publication and closeout. A queued-only MSAS closeout reservation was cancelled after the owner explicitly prioritized finishing OPS3-09; no MSAS candidate/base had been activated or prepared under that reservation.

next_action: OPS3-09 is closed. Persistent implementation lanes are msas, mrcs and mvps. Continue only the lane requested by the owner; do not collapse or serialize the other two.

protections: persistent implementation lanes are exactly msas, mrcs and mvps

MRCS-01 independently selected_not_started with its own checkpoint
MVPS-10 independently selected_not_started under canonical mvps lane
